_provenance: Global summon banners from 2023-08-17 to end of service (2024-10-30), plus two missing Dec 2022 featured banners and date fixes for older wiki-dated banners. Built by ios-server/devtools/build_late_banners.py; report: ios-server/research/LATE_BANNERS.md. 2023-08..2023-11 come from Global news archived on the Wayback Machine (exchange-shop pages name every banner of a unit release and print when its Summon Coins expired, used as the banner end; ticket/deal pages print periods). Nothing later is archived: 2023-12 .. 2024-08 banners are rebuilt from the Global unit release dates (wiki Update Schedule), the shipped client's gacha name list (MST_GACHA_NAME, created in weekly blocks) and the cached Global art of the 92000xx banners; every inferred date, step layout or cost says GUESSED in notes. Pools are given as tier rates + featured units + pool_rule (released_by / exclude), not expanded unit lists. Real-money summons (Treasure, Treasure Replica, value/bonus Lapis) use Lapis stand-ins as in gacha_deals.json. "Fortune Summon" (paid 11 with four 5★+) and the 8th-anniversary Player's Voice voting entries are not rebuilt.
